# Lasya Traders

> Lasya Traders is a wholesale grocery and store-supplies shop serving Chandur, Telangana, India.

## Website
- Homepage: https://lasyatradersshops.netlify.app/

## Business
- Name: Lasya Traders
- Location served: Chandur, Telangana, India
- Offering: Wholesale grocery and store supplies

For current product availability, prices, and ordering details, use the website.
